system.description:
A dangerous technique often only used as a last resort or trump card. By expending mana and pushing it directly into the Soul, one can empower their very essence.

Choose an amount of Mana to expend (1–3). Your Soul Stat increases by that amount for 5 Rounds.

When the effect ends, roll Magykal Resistance. If your result is lower than [9 + amount of Mana you expended], you gain Scorched Veins until you visit a Spring of Life.

Scorched Veins: Your maximum Health is reduced by 5 and you lose 2 Health for every Mana you expend.
system.other_restrictions: 1–3 Mana | Cannot be used while inflicted by Scorched Veins
